title: Beginning Theory

vibeProfile.oneLine: A clear, friendly first introduction to literary and cultural theory.

summary: Peter Barry's Beginning Theory is one of the most popular first introductions to literary and cultural theory, explaining structuralism, post-structuralism, psychoanalysis, feminism, postcolonialism and more in plain, friendly language. Each chapter breaks a difficult approach into clear steps and shows it applied to real texts. Reassuring and genuinely useful, it is the book many students turn to when theory first bewilders them, and a reliable companion throughout a literature degree.
whyReadIt: The friendliest first introduction to theory, plain-spoken and genuinely useful. The book students reach for when theory bewilders.
